title: The 5 Trends Have Happened - Now What?
speaker: TheTechnicalTraders host (Chris Vermeulen)

macro_themes.view: Money is leaving tech for the rest of the market rather than leaving stocks, so equal-weight S&P is rising while Nasdaq lags.
Hot inflation data sent a shockwave and a gap down, producing a short-term washout low.
10-year yield and dollar are pulling back as expected after hitting measured-move targets, which should help metals bounce modestly.

calls.condition: Relief bounce could roll over as in the prior gap-down episode, with 5-day below a down-sloping 20-day.
calls.reason: Protective stop hit and a trend-exit signal ended the Nasdaq uptrend; short-term downtrend by moving averages.
calls.quote: we have the trend coming to an end. We don't want to be holding the Nasdaq at this point.

calls.reason: S&P trend signal still long; oversold/panic selling washout and broad rally in equal-weight RSP, though FOMO may cause a short pause.
calls.quote: the S&P 500 is still up, still long. It's holding up much better.

calls.condition: Pullback should hold the 38-50% Fibonacci retracement to set up a higher high; deeper than 50% damages the chart.
calls.reason: Yield hit its 100% measured move and is pulling back in a controlled, bullish 38% retracement.
calls.quote: 38 to 50% is considered a bullish pullback.

calls.reason: Dollar pulling back along with yields, as expected.
calls.quote: we are starting to see that dollar pull back as expected.

calls.condition: If the dollar bounces and rallies, metals likely break down in a much bigger way.
calls.reason: All trends down; expects sideways or slight drift up as a pause, with platinum/palladium weakness signalling low demand in the sector.
calls.quote: Because all of the trends are down for gold and silver, we're not really expecting them to rally.

calls.reason: Series of lower highs after a huge drop; big chart points to $39.
calls.quote: our downside target for silver is still $39 per ounce... it still could take months

calls.reason: Big pop is a counter-trend rally; all moving averages sloping down.
calls.quote: These are bounces within a downtrend, and that is what's important.

calls.reason: Working higher toward targets; time cycles suggest a high around early November.
calls.quote: 115, 120 are the upside targets... we would be getting that high around early November

calls.reason: Palladium has broken down, leading the precious-metals complex lower.
calls.quote: palladium break down and sell off... kind of leading the way saying there's not a whole lot of excitement.

notes: '10-year note pulling back' read as the yield (he pairs it with 'bonds bouncing'). Oil second target 120 kept in resistance; 115 used as target. NQ short-term recorded mixed (bounce vs rollover undecided).
